what: 万物类象 — three axes. A symbol runs in several 象 (文书, 房产, 长辈…); each 象 is a family of concrete things (合同, 证书, 执照…); and separately the symbol has 动词象意 — what that force DOES. Static data, never generated.
why: A reading names ONE thing: 父母 becomes 文书. Left there, a reader takes 文书 to mean 证书 and stops — the word is a category, not an instance, and flattening the two into one comma-list hid that. So the library keeps them apart: click the word to see which 象 it came from, click an 象 to see what it actually turns up as. Only the pairing (word ↔ symbol) is ever written by the model.

zh: 口碑、名声传出去的那部分

en: the thing that has stalled in a standoff
the step that is hard to get over
the outsiders you deal with daily
a fad that comes in waves

zh: 一门手艺做出来的东西
那个能替你挡一下的东西
en: whatever takes the hit for you

zh: 能自己转起来的那部分

en: the account of things that settles you
the part that keeps you fed
the thing you avoid thinking about
the step you cannot go around
what will not be put down
the bad thing you did not choose
what you have to work with

zh: 你被什么托着、被什么压着
en: what holds you up and what bears down

zh: 轮不到你决定的那部分
en: the part that is not yours to decide
still on the surface, moving underneath
a fright that comes to nothing
being held and not let go

matching.note: How the renderer finds symbols the reading wrote literally. Precision over recall: a false underline on 离开 pointing at the Fire trigram is worse than a missed one, so single characters match only where the context makes them unambiguous.

relations.note: The 六亲 ring. Fixed by the method, identical on every board, so the closing chain is computed rather than written.
